children: Meta Platforms CEO Mark Zuckerberg says the costs of running the company's Muse AI models and agents are currently high, but should improve as the underlying computing grows more efficient. "In the near term, Muse is very compute intensive to run, but we expect to improve its cost efficiency by more than 10x in the next year," Zuckerberg says on an earnings call. "If compute efficiency continues improving quickly for another few years, which we think is highly likely, then Muse will be highly profitable over multiple years." In the meantime, he says, Meta's core business will allow it to scale up Muse despite the heavy costs. (elias.schisgall@wsj.com)
